host: The existing unit-scale PointStudy station in the prepared XR project; the full printed Lines renderer remains supplied.

incoming.provenance: The exact current, printed and verified Lines state, descended from student-built Point One and Coordinates.

operations.before:
var point_b: XRToolsPickable
var line: MeshInstance3D
var distance := 0.0
operations.after:
var positions: Array[Vector3] = []
var trail: Node3D

operations.before:
point_b = point.duplicate() as XRToolsPickable
    point_b.position = CENTRE + Vector3(1.0, 0, 0)
    add_child(point_b)

    line = LineSkin.new()
    add_child(line)

var a := local_position
    var b := to_local(point_b.global_position)
    var displacement := b - a
    distance = displacement.length()
    line.show_segment(a, displacement, distance)
    readout.text += "\nDISTANCE " + str(distance)
